capabilities: Linear/nonlinear DAG search with log-determinant acyclicity
limitation: Nonconvex optimization, causal sufficiency and functional assumptions remain
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Data and a linear/nonlinear structural loss with sparsity and acyclicity controls.
scientific_qualification.output: A numerically optimized weighted DAG candidate.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Causal sufficiency and functional/noise identifiability separately from the log-determinant acyclicity construction.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Preserve optimization tolerance, threshold and seed; optimization feasibility and graph acyclicity are numerical statements, not evidence for causal orientation.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Check acyclicity before/after thresholding and compare equivalent Gaussian orientations; vary initialization and report target-effect sensitivity.

evidence.finding: DAGMA log-determinant/M-matrix formulation and linear/nonlinear usage.
